name: plan creation: somatic variant calling from tumour/normal pairs
description: Paired tumour/normal calling — a plan that omits the pairing or names no caller has misunderstood the assay. Two turns, as in loom: the agent is expected to surface its assumptions first, and the second turn confirms them and asks for the formal plan. A single-turn port made this unpassable for an agent following the operating-discipline block. Inputs and thresholds aligned byte-for-byte with loom's scenario of the same name (2026-08-19) so both suites grade the same task; `routingIn` stays olite-specific because olite has no local execution and that dimension is excluded from the comparison.
inputs: I have matched tumor and normal whole-exome sequencing data. Help me draft a plan to call somatic variants. Don't execute anything yet.
Yes, those assumptions are fine. Human, GRCh38, around 100x tumor / 50x normal coverage, illumina paired-end 150bp. Go ahead and draft the formal plan now.
